claim: A comparative assessment of e-learning and m-learning adoption in South Africa distributed questionnaires among students at North-West University and Vaal University of Technology.
quote: In carrying out this research, we distributed questionnaires among students of the North-West University, South Africa in all the three (3) campuses and Vaal University of Technology (VUT), South Africa.
message: The quoted passage directly supports the claim. The source explicitly states that questionnaires were distributed among students at North-West University (all three campuses) and Vaal University of Technology in South Africa, which matches the claim's assertion of a comparative assessment involving these two institutions.
